claim: The Amazon Inspector guide states that when you activate Amazon Inspector (or Amazon EC2 scanning) for the first time, the account is automatically enrolled in hybrid scanning, which uses agent-based scanning for instances with the SSM agent installed and configured and agentless scanning for eligible EBS-backed instances that aren't SSM managed. One sentence in the scan mode section of the same page instead calls agent-based scanning the default scan mode for newly activated accounts.

qualifiers.condition: the EC2 scanning page contradicts itself once; three statements on two pages say hybrid scanning is enabled automatically

evidence.quote: When you activate Amazon Inspector for the first time, your account is automatically enrolled in hybrid scanning, which uses both scan methods.

For eligible EC2 instances that have the SSM agent installed and configured, Amazon Inspector uses the agent-based method. For eligible instances that aren't SSM managed, Amazon Inspector will use the agentless method for eligible EBS-backed instances.
Hybrid scanning mode includes agent-based and agentless scans and is automatically enabled when you activate Amazon EC2 scanning.
By default, when you activate Amazon EC2 scanning, you automatically enable hybrid scanning mode.
This is the default scan mode for newly activated accounts.
